name: bj-property-gains-tax
description: Prepare a Benin property-disposal tax working paper under the taxe sur les plus-values immobilieres. This Guide screens private immovable disposals, the business-balance-sheet exemption, property-rich company classification and the separate mining-title collection route. For supported ordinary property sales it identifies the acquisition evidence, separates land and construction, computes the deemed construction gain, and compares gain-based tax with the sale-price minimum. It also identifies the seller, registration payment point and public-officer responsibility. Two executable examples distinguish a private sale from an exempt business asset and show the construction/minimum interaction. Reference acquisition values, securities bases, mining arrangements, treaty relief, disputed or gratuitous valuations and authenticated filing require further evidence.
